name: job-queue-workspace
description: Wide-intake, ranked-output job aggregation pipeline plus an application-tracking web UI.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @job-queue/core && npm run build --workspace @job-queue/web
scripts.//pre-scripts: apps/web and e2e import @job-queue/core through its package exports, i.e. packages/core/dist. Without these, a core change that adds an export makes the web tests, the e2e typecheck and the e2e specs fail against a stale dist - a confusing failure that has nothing to do with the code under test. npm runs a pre<script> automatically.
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @job-queue/core && npm run typecheck --workspace @job-queue/web && npm run typecheck --workspace @job-queue/e2e
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace @job-queue/core && npm run test --workspace @job-queue/web
scripts.dev: npm run build:core && node scripts/run-web.mjs dev
scripts.web: npm run build:core && node scripts/run-web.mjs start
